messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: greedy maximal-packing via simulated annealing on area minima

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Simulated annealing with an energy function equal to the negative of the minimum area over all 286 triangles, neighbor moves perturbing single points by Gaussian steps with exponentially decaying temperature, and occasional hard restarts from the best-found configuration converges to an arrangement of 13 points in the unit square with minimum triangle area approximately 0.00230, exceeding any known grid or structured construction."}
